# Commentary golden fixture

`burnley-bournemouth.npz` is the immutable trajectory for Footy's curated Burnley 2–4 Bournemouth recording (`match_2026_20_3`, run `run_1791240220_7b08d5`). It is generated simulation data, not a live campaign save. The matching presentation timeline and verification record are tracked under `assets/matches/full-match-recordings/`.

Keeping the trace here makes score attribution, timing and anti-spoiler tests reproducible in a fresh clone without the original local season output.
